notes.title: DragonStone Content Update v1.011
notes.content:
This minor post release content update v1.011 adds 2 new movies, including a transition outro for the new and improved prologue illustration sequence, as well as a new Misty intro movie that plays in the King's Chamber when Misty is first introduced. 

Along with the added content videos, we applies a few fixes to typos and various clean up for playback in transitions from scenes, as well as fixing a replay bug where the first masturabtion scene with Myranda would keep playing if you kept going back to her house before you visited the borderlands.

notes.title: DragonStone Patch v1.011
notes.content: This minor patch fixes a bug found in Castle Balfor where if the player immediately enters the Ladymaids Chambers, the story skips ahead and advances to the encounter with Myranda and Kylara. Now players will see the proper flow of the Ladymaids entering the King's Bedchamber

notes.title: Post Launch Tweak Patch v1.009
notes.content:
You have spoken and we have heard you. We've been listening to the community and appreciate that you hated the intro prologue in that style and felt that it did not accurately represent the quality of the rest of the game. 

Update v1.09 adds new high resolution final Illustration prologue selection that now allows players to choose a completely new intro prologue that was created by our in house background artist using the original images as reference.

The new sequence of all new images now more accurately fits the high quality style and look of the rest of our game. We always intended to create a unique and visually stunning intro sequence to help players understand the lore of Valtoria, and now we have something at launch that we are happy to share with you.

notes.title: DragonStone Release patch v1.008
notes.content: This is a minor release day patch for some blurry images that have been improved as well as several spell errors that have been corrected.
